response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically versatile individual contributor with deep experience in developer tools, testing frameworks, and build/CI infrastructure, but the resume shows no evidence of people management experience — he has never held a formal management title, doesn't mention conducting one-on-ones, performance reviews, or managing direct reports. The role explicitly requires 2+ years of people management, which is a hard requirement he does not meet.
strengths: Extensive experience building developer tools, test runners (Trial), assertion libraries, and CI/CD infrastructure
Strong track record across many languages/platforms (web, mobile, embedded), showing technical breadth and adaptability
Experience mentoring and teaching via workshops, Code Katas, and courses, showing some leadership/knowledge-sharing inclination
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or direct reports at any point in 15+ years of experience
No mention of setting team roadmaps, organizational priorities, or leading organizational change
Career trajectory is consistently IC-focused (Senior/Staff Developer titles), not trending toward management

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools & testing infrastructure background
No demonstrated strategic roadmap or org-change leadership
